The strongest evidence points to **emailservice unavailability**. Starting at 08:49, checkoutservice logs report order-confirmation failures with `no healthy upstream`; checkoutservice p90 latency also rises from 0.2 to 0.4–0.5 around this period. Emailservice’s memory and open sockets increase at the same time, while its CPU remains low. The telemetry does not establish why emailservice became unavailable, but it supports a **loss/availability fault**, not CPU saturation.

Likely propagation: emailservice failures affect checkoutservice, which is called by frontend. The frontend metrics shown remain steady, so they do not independently confirm a frontend-side fault.
